component.name: Zalos
component.summary: Ultra-lightweight native Qt6 desktop client for Zalo on Linux

description.p: Zalos is an open-source, ultra-lightweight native Linux messaging client for Zalo built with Qt6 (C++17 and QML). It delivers a tiny memory footprint (~40-65MB RAM), sub-second cold startup, smooth 60 FPS graphics (software renderer by default, optional GPU acceleration), native Wayland and X11 support, adaptive system theming, and local End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) database synchronization.

ul.li: Native Wayland and Xorg dual-engine support with smooth Client-Side Decorations (CSD).
Adaptive Dark/Light theme following GNOME (Adwaita) and KDE (Breeze) desktop settings.
Native C++ cryptographic verification for E2EE message history (db-cross-v4).
StatusNotifierItem system tray integration with dynamic unread message badge count.
Ultra-low resource consumption: starts instantaneously with minimal CPU and RAM usage (~40–65 MB).
1-1 and group voice/video calling engine with OpenH264 video encoding.
Desktop utilities: screenshot capture (Ctrl+Alt+S), file transfer, location map previews, zBusiness tools, Kiki assistant and My Documents browser.

description.p: Full zBusiness Tools API integration (live business profile lookup, product catalog & product CRUD, and server-synced auto-reply rules), Zalo-style OpenStreetMap tile preview cards with sender avatar pins for shared locations, full-width horizontal panoramic image rendering, NativeTextRendering COLRv1 emoji fixes, universal bundled Qt 6.8.3 LTS runtime with QML AOT compilation across .deb, .rpm, AppImage, Flatpak, Snap, and Nix, SQLite label caching for instant startup, desktop System Theme color/font synchronization fixes, responsive narrow-window (480x440+) layouts, async call device discovery, 32-frame pre-auth WebSocket queuing, non-blocking local file open, and DPR/memory optimizations. Also fixes the interface font falling back to the emoji font when the desktop font is missing (now Noto Sans), links that did not open in the browser (with a notice when no browser is installed) or could not be clicked, and zBusiness catalog error 113; file choosers now use the desktop's native dialog, packages are about 4 MB smaller, and each architecture is compiled once for .deb, AppImage and .rpm.

Fixed being stuck on "Connecting to server" (WebSocket error 501) on Qt 6.4, a crash with fractional scaling on Wayland, the AppImage falling back to its bundled Qt after a normal exit, the chat jumping back to the bottom while scrolling up, and missing images when opening conversations after reading photo+text sequences on your phone. Also keeps 1-1 call relay servers alive during long ringing, adds seamless P2P-to-relay network handover and audio recovery across Wi-Fi/VPN changes, adds an Auto/Manual microphone gain toggle in the call device menu, improves two-phase Phone History Sync v2 with idle-phone wake-up and quote/mention/TTL metadata, and fixes group_poll host fallback and quote reply normalization. New installs now start in English, and the AppImage uses the system Qt only from 6.4 to 6.12.

Zalo PC-style polls with a full vote dialog and all creation settings, chats read on the phone now sync as read, phone history sync no longer fails when the phone app goes to the background, poll voting fixes, lower image/video viewer memory, software rendering by default with automatic fallback when the GPU renderer fails, fewer required system packages, no crash on systems without media codecs, and a safer choice between the system and bundled Qt in the AppImage.

Fixed call hangup signaling so ending accepted 1-1 or group calls cleanly terminates the remote peer, fixed group chat sidebar previews and notifications missing sender names, fixed photo clicks not opening the image viewer, and added performance, media-engine, and packaging hardening.
Phone history sync v2 fallback (native OpenSSL 3 implementation), flexible system/runtime libzstd support, Qt 6.4 QML compatibility fixes, and thread-safe avatar loading.

Self-contained AppImage (~22 MB) with bundled Qt 6.4 fallback and glibc 2.35 compatibility (Ubuntu 22.04+ and other modern Linux distributions), canonical MIT license and AppStream validation fixes, and full Qt 6.4 QML compatibility across all components.

Lower idle and active memory (scene-graph/GPU texture release when hidden to tray, MADV_COLD/KSM hints, GLIBC_TUNABLES, minimal Qt plugin path filtering, lazy QtMultimedia/FFmpeg and H.264 init, separate Avatar/Media RAM caches); pauses hidden animations, carousel and presence polling; non-blocking startup theme probes and lazy sticker store; incremental ContactModel and virtualized group member list; streaming 64 KiB ZDB4 decryption, batched off-thread mobile history sync and indexed offline SQLite queries; optimized 640x360 camera selection, active-stream group video decode and LTO release builds.

Mobile history sync retries transient download errors; chat no longer jumps back to the newest message when scrolling up; accurate call status with microphone and speaker warnings; faster reconnects after network changes or resume; faster, lighter message and conversation lists; My Documents has its own button; chat info panel fits narrow windows.

Calls run on Zalos's own C++ engine with no Node.js or Python needed; fixed a crash when starting a call; lower memory use from lazily created pages and menus and a dedicated image path for chat photos.

Native C++ browser session reader, in-chat system notices and message logs for started/completed calls, mention cursor auto-positioning, unread group mentions filter in Direct tab, and call overlay controls alignment.

Group voice and video calls with participant state, the My Documents media/file/link browser, Kiki Assistant and zBusiness tool destinations, call and group actions hidden on official accounts, contacts quick actions, and a hardened mobile history sync.
Layered chat background blur, full-resolution cover and avatar images, faster packaging builds, unread badge resurrection fix, VoIP reject status handling, and session cookies scoped to Zalo domains.

Interactive draft attachments bar for multi-file queueing, in-app image viewer annotation canvas with drawing tools, window geometry persistence, dock unread counter, audio-only incoming call acceptance, and ARM64 AppImage release packaging.
Duplicate-message fix for mobile history resync (cliMsgId dedup), text emoticons rendered as emoji, a photo viewer that no longer initialises a media backend, and a minified GitHub Pages deployment.
Idle memory trimming and cache optimizations, complete mobile history sync with 64-bit znoise resolution, in-app video playback, avatar/background viewer, and ARM64 Nix build fixes.
First published release: pure Qt6 architecture, E2EE decryptor, and AppImage/RPM/.deb/Nix packaging for x86_64 and aarch64.
